title: Generalized Tadmor Conditions and Structure-Preserving Numerical Fluxes for the Compressible Flow of Real Gases
summary: We generalize Tadmor's algebraic numerical flux condition for entropy-conservative discretizations of conservation laws to a broader class of secondary structures, i.e. possibly non-convex secondary quantities whose evolution can consist of both conservative and non-conservative contributions. The resulting generalized Tadmor condition yields a discrete local balance law for secondary structures alongside the discrete conservation law that is solved.
